title: CR-014 Inkflow Figure
description: Source-conditioned art-style transformation: translate the verified CR-001 adult fashion photograph into a contemporary expressive Chinese ink figure painting on an absorbent album-leaf support. Uses art_style_transform + chinese_ink_painting + album_leaf + newly_created. No TransformationPack (painting ArtMethod has no concept_refs; fragments emit on the non-lexical compiler path). Empty EraPack list—no dynasty authenticity claim and no named historical artist attribution. Symbolic reference roles only; binary reference packaging is out of PromptRecipe scope. Operator must supply the verified CR-001 PNG (SHA-256 0dcf8af6cac15441d5e728f98ac53314442984d3a27a5dd193effa2bac46f41e) as the image input at generation time. See docs/CR_014_INKFLOW_FIGURE.md. No gallery image attached.

semantic_spec.request: Transform the referenced adult fashion photograph into a contemporary expressive Chinese ink figure painting on an absorbent album-leaf painting support. Preserve recognizable visual identity of the source adult figure, the distinguishing standing stance and key anatomical proportions, the overall evening-gown silhouette including the draped neckline and major gathered-fabric architecture, and the hairstyle silhouette, while explicitly authorizing selective omission of nonessential fine garment seams, minor folds and pleats, satin microtexture and gloss, photographic skin detail, photographic shadow gradients, and fine incidental background detail—do not reconstruct the gown through exhaustive line tracing. Translate photographic skin, satin reflectance, and continuous tonal modeling into confident variable calligraphic brushwork with tapered stroke beginnings and endings, directional brush rhythm following anatomy and major garment structure, wet diluted washes for broad tonal masses with controlled feathering on absorbent support, dry-brush drag for selected structural accents, and a coherent ink-density hierarchy from purposeful untouched support through pale gray wash and intermediate diluted ink to dark structural marks with selective concentrated black accents. Keep intentional negative space that participates in silhouette, body-versus-gown separation, selected overlapping garment masses, and surrounding composition—not a blank backdrop alone. Keep the modern fashion wardrobe modern—do not invent historical Chinese costume, jewelry, hair ornaments, accessories, written calligraphy text, red seals, signatures, dynasty attribution, or named historical artist claims. The result must read as expressive Chinese ink figure painting—not a living photograph with black watercolor or ink-texture overlay, not a uniform grayscale or sepia digital fashion illustration, not gongbi fine-line meticulous contour-and-layered-color painting with uniform thin outlines and exhaustive fold tracing, not Japanese woodblock or relief-print appearance with keyblock carving, separated printing-block registration, kentō marks, or baren-impression simulation, not Western watercolor substitution, not anime or cartoon rendering, not uniform vector line art, not random decorative black splatter without structural brush logic, not photorealistic airbrushed facial gradients, and not a handmade historical painting. Keep album-leaf-conscious composition with readable full-figure fashion hierarchy in a 4:5 field and restrained contemporary presentation, with no logos or invented typography.
